messages.content: Repair the rejected macro arc. Preserve source meaning, chronology, and explicit contrast boundaries. Return only the complete repaired macro arc JSON.

SOURCE STORY
A realistic action film about a woman, Amy, protecting her two kids (Will and Amber) from a zombie apocalypse.
Amy is at home on a normal day, wearing a tight, black tank top and denim jeans, cooking breakfast for her young kids.
Suddenly, a zombie breaks the kitchen door window and Amy sees the danger. She rushes her kids to the basement, gets them inside, and then locks the door.
She retrieves her hidden arsenal consisting of a pistol and a katana. She equips the weapons.

The majority of the film is Amy killing (dismembering, decapitating, etc.) zombies as they try and attack her.
Amy kills the last of the zombies, her house now soaked in blood. She lets her kids out of the basement.

VALIDATOR ISSUE
The explicit majority sequence is under-allocated at 3/8 beats; at least 5/8 are required.

ALLOCATION REPAIR RULES
- More than half of all beats must materially belong to the emphasized zombie-conflict sequence.
- At most 3 beats may occur outside that sequence.
- IMPORTANT CONTRAST BOUNDARY: when SOURCE STORY explicitly establishes an ordinary/calm/normal baseline and then explicitly introduces a sudden/inciting threat or change ("suddenly", "then the attack begins", etc.), NEVER merge that inciting threat/change into the baseline beat. The baseline must remain its own beat so the contrast is visible.
- Treat that protected baseline beat as one of the available outside-sequence beats. Compress the remaining setup/preparation instead.
- The inciting threat MAY share its beat with its immediate reaction/escape/containment sequence.
- Retrieval and equipping of the same named equipment MAY share one beat.
- Preserve every explicit source action in order.
- The emphasized conflict must begin by Beat 4 at the latest.
- The final conflict beat may also contain immediate resolution.

For this source, Beat 1 must remain the ordinary breakfast baseline with no zombie/threat content. Reallocate Beats 2-3 as needed so Beats 4-8 are the emphasized conflict.

Return the complete repaired 8-beat macro arc JSON only.
